mapper.insert: insert into message(messageId,messageSender, messageReciver, messageDate, messageInfo, messageType, messageRead) values (#{messageId},#{messageSender}, #{messageReciver}, #{messageDate}, #{messageInfo}, #{messageType}, #{messageRead})
mapper.select: select * from message where ((messageSender = #{messageSender} and messageReciver = #{messageReciver}) or messageSender = #{messageReciver} or messageReciver = #{messageReciver}) order by messageDate asc
select * from message where messageSender = #{messageReciver} or messageReciver = #{messageReciver} order by messageDate asc

select top 1 messageInfo from message where ((messageSender = #{messageSender} and messageReciver = #{messageReciver}) or (messageSender = #{messageReciver} and messageReciver = #{messageSender})) and messageSender<>0 order by messageDate desc
select top 1 messageInfo from message where (messageSender = #{messageSender} or messageReciver = #{messageSender}) order by messageDate desc
